waterfront_evidence: Re-checked 2026-11-23 at AWH's request (supersedes the owner note 'Campsites are not waterfront'). Sources: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880303 (all 164 campsiteDetails pages read 2026-11-23: GIS pins, category, driveway, photos), the booking site's own Looking-for filter (RV 17 sites, Trailer 53, Tent 121; 131/133/137/138 appear only under Tent), DCNR Caledonia 'Stay' page (read 2026-11-23: Hosack Run 'moderately level, open, and shaded sites'), NHD flowlines (Hosack Run and Conococheague Creek both perennial, fcode 46006), USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar, PEMA 2018-2020 leaf-off orthoimagery (PASDA) and Esri World_Imagery. Photos (all viewed and rendered; uploaded to the booking site 2025-09-23): CALE_HosackRun_133_2 shows dark stream water through the trunks at the right rear, across open, gently falling forest floor with no road, trail or brush between; CALE_HosackRun_133_1 shows the gravel back-in pad into open forest, water not clearly visible; CALE_HosackRun_131_1 shows the gravel pad, open root-laced forest floor and the wooden rail of the access-road bridge over the run to the east; CALE_HosackRun_131_2 shows the pad among trees, no water visible; photos of 134-138, 140-144, 146, 147, 181-183 look into the loop and show no water. Geometry (lidar, 1 m steps, pad pin to the channel thalweg of Hosack Run just above its confluence with Stillhouse Run/Conococheague Creek; channel floor 5-7 m wide, so creek-size, not river): 131 (Modern Non-Electric, booking category Tent, back-in gravel driveway 40 ft): 21-23 m to the channel, pad 2.2-2.4 m above the channel floor, average slope 10-12%, steepest 2-m stretch 28% (15 deg), open forest floor between on the NE line; due east the line instead ends at the road culvert/bridge with its rail fence. 133 (Modern Non-Electric, category Tent, driveway 35 ft, posts Overhead Clearance 7 and Hike In Distance 40): 21-26 m, pad 2.5-2.75 m above the channel floor, average 12%, steepest 2-m stretch 21-25% (12-14 deg), open forest floor, water seen on photo. Both banks are well inside the walkable slope of the AWH 2026-11-23 bank ruling (<=40%/22 deg) but 0.2-0.7 m higher than its 1-2 m example. Not qualifying: 137/138 (Tent) 28 m, 2.75 m drop, steepest 34-39% with a mound between, no water on photos; 134/135/136/140 (Trailer) 34-37 m with other sites or a rise between, 2.2-2.5 m, no water on photos; 141-147 and the rest of Hosack Run 40-145 m and up to 6.8 m above; Chinquapin Hill (001-130) sits on the hillside 95 m or more from the Conococheague with a bluff and US-30 side between (nearest 051-054 at 95-106 m). Group tent sites 001-005 and the pavilions do not count. Every booking page's 'Distance to Lake/Stream: Greater than 300 feet' is uniform across all 164 sites and is contradicted by the lidar and photos at 131/133, so it was treated as boilerplate.
note: Two Hosack Run sites, 131 and 133, sit about 70-85 ft from Hosack Run just above where it meets the Conococheague, down a gentle wooded slope about 8 ft high with nothing between; the booking site lists both as non-electric sites under its tent category (40- and 35-ft back-in gravel driveways), and 133 posts a 7-ft overhead clearance. The other sites, and all of Chinquapin Hill, are set back from the water. --Claude
curation_note: 2026-11-23 waterfront re-check at AWH's request: 'not waterfront' raised to creekside on sites 131 and 133 (lidar + booking-site photos). Replaced owner note: 'Campground along Conococheague Creek.  Campsites are not waterfront. --AWH'. Open for AWH: (1) pads sit 2.2-2.75 m above the run, above the bank ruling's 1-2 m example though the slope (steepest 2-m stretch 21-28%) is gentle; (2) Hosack Run is a small run (channel 5-7 m) - reaching it is easy, paddling it is not; (3) both sites appear only in the booking site's Tent search (all Caledonia non-electric sites do, including pull-through 127), and 133 posts Overhead Clearance 7 ft and Hike In Distance 40 ft.
